Allahabad HC asks for Centre, ASI response on Taj Mahal survey plea

The Allahabad High Court has requested responses from the central government and the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) regarding a petition seeking a survey of the Taj Mahal. The petition is based on a claim that the monument was originally a Hindu temple. This development follows a previous instance where the government reportedly dismissed similar claims.
